The limitation subclaim requires SYSTEM_LIMITATIONS_AND_APPROXIMATIONS_v1.md; the snapshot-boundary subclaim requires SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md. Neither is cited. It is not a document that can be modified through a documentation refactor without explicit governance workflow authorization (CLAUDE.md Section 15: 'Any action that bypasses enforced workflow execution is considered invalid and non-compliant'). Modifying CLAUDE.md itself via a terminology refactor workflow is a strong governance claim that requires system-orchestration.yaml explicit authorization for this action class. No such authorization is cited.
checked_claims.reason: CLAUDE.md is both the governance authority AND the proposed target of modification. Modifying the constitutional document requires explicit authorization from system-orchestration.yaml workflow definition — treating CLAUDE.md simultaneously as authority and modification target without explicit workflow authorization creates a self-referential governance conflict that must be resolved before any change proceeds.
checked_claims.notes: CONFLICT NOTE: CLAUDE.md Section 11 (Document Update Obligations) specifies that contract-affecting changes must trigger review of CLAUDE.md. A terminology refactor of CLAUDE.md itself is necessarily a contract-affecting change. This requires the document update obligation to authorize its own modification, which is a governance escalation case. Recommended action: explicit system-orchestration.yaml workflow step must authorize CLAUDE.md modification before the refactor scope includes it.

summary.notes: Four claims are RC-4 (conflict_requires_block): C-001, C-002, C-003, C-008. Two claims are RC-3 (role_mismatch): C-005, C-007. Two claims are RC-2 (review_only): C-004, C-006. No claims are RC-1 (compliant). Blocking conditions: (1) Strong architecture claims C-001 and C-002 lack role-matched citations from SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md. (2) C-002 carries an additional semantic conflict — 'decision_layer' implies an operational layer, contradicting CLAUDE.md Section 3.2 which classifies all Layer 3 components as unbuilt target architecture. (3) C-003 asserts a strict naming convention without SYSTEM_TECHNICAL_HANDBOOK_v1.md authorization. (4) C-008 proposes modifying CLAUDE.md without explicit system-orchestration.yaml workflow authorization for constitutional document modification. Critical escalation: the proposed term 'decision_layer' must be evaluated against CLAUDE.md Section 10 strong-claim discipline — if adopted in canonical documents, it may constitute a forbidden strong claim ('Layer 3 is implemented') by implication. Doc-sync escalation is required for: canonical document rename governance (C-004), CLAUDE.md self-modification authorization (C-008), and semantic conflict on 'decision_layer' (C-002).
